split_policy: Reviewed independent repository-family train/val assignments; global exact/near dedup precedes FIM and packing.
reasoning_scope: Original mathematical exposition, proofs and exercises from Mathematics in Lean and Open Logic (train), with independent Logic and Proof (validation); narrow mathematical reasoning, not broad instruction following or fabricated trajectories.
inherited_data_note: Pilot sources are reused at their original pinned revisions; new candidate sources pinned separately. Frozen pilot remains unchanged.
review_note: Candidate source subsets with explicit splits; measured corpus gates required before freeze or training.
